rationale: The stock gapped down ~7.7% on strong earnings (beat on revenue, EPS, and comps), which is a classic "sell the news" reaction, but price has since recovered sharply from the $97.55 low to $106.06, now sitting at 83% of today's range and pressing against the 9-EMA with declining 1-minute volume and a series of lower closes in the last three candles. With an existing working long in HOOD and limited incremental edge here, skipping preserves capital.
